# Handover Continuation — 2026-08-13

## Session Summary

Full-day session on the TCTBP-Adviser app (Vite + React + TypeScript, Tailwind, vitest). A long run of UX/minimalism refinements plus one new feature, all following the user's direction to "only show relevant details" and keep ONE enabled action per surface.

**Shipped today (all committed at `7aac1ff`, published to origin/development):**

1. **Minimalist repository-details page.** New reusable `CollapsiblePanel` (collapsed by default). The TCTBP "installation" + "quality policy" panes merged into one collapsible "TCTBP profile" with a compact gates line. GitHub evidence, known limits, and the branch model are collapsible. Panes with nothing to say are hidden: intent plan (no selection), GitHub (no evidence), known limits (no uncertainties), the "Why this is recommended" strip (healthy repos, then deleted entirely — see below), the upgrade planner (no plan/journey).
2. **Uniform 16px spacing** in the details section (was alternating 16/32px — the grid used `gap-8`/`space-y-8` while `Section` is `space-y-4`).
3. **Single-action-surface principle.** The sticky Take action bar owns every enabled action. Bar-owned plan-step buttons are omitted entirely from the intent plan (not disabled). Step explanations (why / does / does-not) moved into hover/click/focus **callouts** (`Callout.tsx`, `InfoIcon`) on actionable steps.
4. **`RecommendationPanel` deleted.** Its content (reason chip, freshness, does/does-not) was fully redundant with the bar + step callouts. The intent/upgrade grid only renders when a plan or journey exists.
5. **"Verify with status"** — new on-demand audit: runs the repo's own canonical runner `node scripts/tctbp-run-status.js --no-fetch --json` via `POST /api/repositories/:id/verify-status` (`server/status-verify.ts`, `shared/status-verify.ts`, `src/api/verify-status.ts`, `VerifyStatusPanel.tsx`). Lives in the outcome dropdown's `Actions` optgroup. Disabled while a verify is running. Read-only by construction (runner invoked with `--no-fetch`).
6. **Reference library overhaul.** `ReferenceExplorer` retitled "TCTBP surface reference" with a surface summary; workflows grouped into five family sections with counts; compact cards (name/id/purpose/triggers always visible; Runner/Branch rule/Preconditions/Does/Does not/Related/Blocked-by-guardrails behind a per-card "Show details" toggle). Added `chatInvokable` to `WorkflowReference` — 18 workflows marked Chat trigger, only `gate` marked Automated step (it runs inside ship/preflight). Added Surface + Family filters (exported pure `filterWorkflows` for testability).
7. Removed the **Branch-strategy reference** pane from the detail page (duplicated the Branch model pane; its workflow list is library material). Component + tests kept as the seed for a future library section.

**Key decisions / why:** follow the bar-as-owner pattern the user approved earlier; move all explanation into on-demand callouts; keep the Adviser's "No Git fetch · No repository mutation" promise (the canonical `status` runner is NOT wired into periodic refresh — only on-demand, with `--no-fetch`). The `chatInvokable` definition chosen while the user was away = "invoked standalone in conversation" (agent-recognition would mark almost everything; user's example was "orient but not gate").

**Deferred intentionally:** adding a branch-strategy/applicable-workflows section to the reference library (component `RepositoryReferencePanel.tsx` + its tests are kept for this). No other open work.

## Mistakes & Gotchas

- **Callout click race:** an `onClick` toggle on the info button fought `onFocus` (mousedown→focus opens, click→toggle closes) so clicking instantly closed the popover. Fix: no `onClick` — focus (via click or Tab) opens, blur/mouseleave/Escape close.
- **`formatAge` already includes "Observed":** appending `' · Observed '` produced "· Observed Observed just now". Use `' · ' + formatAge(...)`.
- **Multi-edit corruption:** during the single-action-surface edit, one replacement produced a duplicate `|| journeyPastApply` line and stale identifiers — always grep-verify after multi-replaces.
- **`planIntent` can return null:** tests need a `if (!plan) throw` guard before touching `plan.steps`.
- **Search term gotcha in tests:** searching 'ship' also matches Hotfix (its purpose contains "Ship an emergency…"); use unique terms (e.g. 'promote') for exact-set assertions.
- **Memory-file insert split a line** when appended mid-sentence — use str_replace with full-line anchors.
- **Playwright `run_playwright_code` snippets can't use TS `as` casts** — write plain JS in `evaluate` callbacks.
